title: Amnesty for January 8 convicts defended in speech
seoTitle: Amnesty for January 8 Convicts Defended in Speech
subtitle: The topic of amnesty took center stage after recent statements in Rio de Janeiro
excerpt: Amnesty for January 8 convicts was defended during a political event. Read about what was said on the topic and other public safety proposals.
author: Daniele Morais
sourceName: Folha de S.Paulo, G1, Gazeta do Povo
contentHtml:
The debate over amnesty gained significant public traction following recent statements made in Rio de Janeiro. Discussions regarding a pardon for those convicted have become a focal point of the national political landscape.

The defense of amnesty for January 8 convicts

During a public event in Rio de Janeiro, the need to pass a pardon measure was presented as a political priority. The proposal aims to benefit those convicted of the acts that took place on January 8.

For the measure to move forward, the importance of securing support in the National Congress was highlighted. Legislative coordination is seen as the necessary path to enable a broad, general, and unrestricted amnesty for those under investigation and persecuted.

Proposals to toughen public safety

In addition to the amnesty debate, the speech included a series of promises aimed at combating crime. Among the measures mentioned are tougher sentencing and classifying criminal factions as narco-terrorist organizations.

The presented plan also includes proposals such as increasing prison sentences for cell phone theft and adopting chemical castration for those convicted of raping women and children. Lowering the age of criminal responsibility is also part of the advocated agenda.

The political landscape and the elections

The statements were made within the context of an electoral race and the launch of candidacies for state governor and the Presidency of the Republic. The political moment is marked by intense debates over safety and the country's direction.

The public safety agenda continues to occupy a central space in discussions with voters and supporters, serving as a foundation for mobilizing alliances and support in parliament.

With information from Folha de S.Paulo, G1, Gazeta do Povo.
